pages.text: $(italic)"The world will continue to be beautiful."$()$(br2)This record comes from the last exchange between the previous observer and O5-1 Aaron Siegel. O5-1 asked: do you really think so. The observer answered: child, I have never been wrong.
pages.title: Fragment: Aaron's Vow

pages.text: $(bold)Event:$() someone in the previous iteration confirmed that the plan to replace the observer was workable - until then, nobody could guarantee it was possible.$(br2)$(bold)Collection:$() taken from the $(l)relic container$() near the point where the End sovereign falls, after it is terminated.$(br2)$(italic)The container also holds one OBSR-EX, archived at the same time.$()
